_note: Public TOON devnet on Linode. Committed SAMPLE (placeholder DOMAIN). On the live host, devnet.sh regenerates this from .env. Peers point a TOON node/SDK at these URLs (chainRpcUrls / EVM_RPC_URL).

solana._fund: infra/solana/fund-solana.sh <pubkey> — airdrops SOL + transfers mock USDC from the treasury

baseSepolia._fund: curl -X POST https://faucet.<DOMAIN>/api/base-sepolia/request -d '{"address":"0x…"}' → mints 1000 USDC. The mock USDC mint(address,uint256) is UNGATED (anyone can coin fresh tokens to any address), so the faucet key holds no USDC — it only needs Base Sepolia ETH for gas. Per-address 24h cooldown. Basescan: https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0x49beE1Bca5d15Fb0963117923403F9498119a9Ce
baseSepolia._note: PUBLIC Base Sepolia testnet (chainId 84532) — no self-hosted node; the faucet mints against the public RPC. Deployed 2026-07-18.

mina._fund: PERMISSIONLESS MINT (no recipient key, no admin key): npx tsx tools/mina/mint-usdc.mts <recipient-b58> [amount] --token <tokenAddress> --admin-contract <adminContractAddress> — ANY funded fee payer mints up to 1,000 USDC per recipient per ~24h window (480 slots), enforced in-proof + in-ledger (PermissionlessRateLimitedUsdcAdmin). The recipient does NOT sign, so a webpage/connected wallet can mint to a typed-in address and any third-party/on-chain caller can mint to an address. First mint to a fresh recipient funds 2 new accounts (its token account + mint-receipt account), paid by the fee payer (~2 MINA); auto-detected by the CLI. Accepted devnet trade-off: a griefer can burn an address's daily quota by minting junk at it (harmless — mock token, self-heals each window). No admin key mints — admin = pause/upgrade only.
mina._connectorNote: On the live box the connector reads via the minascan upstream directly (the mina.<DOMAIN> proxy 504s on send). Set chainProviders[mina].graphqlUrl to the upstream, tokenAddress/tokenId to these live values. The connector verify path follows the per-claim channelAccount, so client-opened channels work; demoChannelZkApp is a pre-OPEN USDC channel for quick checks (predates this token — settles in the superseded 2026-06 token).
mina._note: Passthrough proxy of the PUBLIC Mina devnet (no node). USDC FungibleToken (UsdcChannelToken, 6dp) gated by the PERMISSIONLESS rate-limited admin (PermissionlessRateLimitedUsdcAdmin: any fee payer mints to ANY address, 1,000 USDC/recipient/~24h enforced in-proof + in-ledger, NO recipient signature; admin key = pause/upgrade ONLY). Receipt counter is an increase-only packed balance (windowStart*2^32 + mintedInWindow) under the admin token id — the only owner-proof-writable field on a fresh recipient-keyed account.
